newsitem.title: GREECE: Silver&Baryte and Bauxites Parnasse merge.
newsitem.headline: Silver&Baryte and Bauxites Parnasse merge.

text.p: The merger of Silver & Baryte with Bauxites Parnasse is moving ahead after shareholders of both companies gave a green light for the plan on Wednesday.
Silver & Baryte will increase its share capital by 1.676 billion drachmas, issuing 2,660,650 new common bearer shares with a par value of 630 drachmas, it said in a statement.
After the merger, the new company's share capital will be 5.613 billion divided into 8,911,000 shares.
"After the share swap, Bauxite Parnasse shareholders will have a 29.85 percent stake in the new company," the company said.

Bauxites Parnasse, Europe's largest bauxite producer, has reserves of 120 million tonnes which can last for another 100 years. It exports 60 percent of its output with the remainder sold to Aluminium of Greece.
The merger will boost Silver & Baryte's turnover and profits and help expand sales with new products.

The post-merger new company sees sales rising to 19 billion drachmas in 1996, bringing in profits of 3.7 billion. The estimate includes only second half earnings and sales revenue by Bauxites Parnasse.
"The real picture of the new company will appear in 1997 with sales exceeding 25 billion drachmas and pretax earnings growing to 4.5 billion," Silver & Baryte said.
